leads.title: Surinamese Penal Code, Articles 175, 175a and 176 (2015 amendment)
leads.documents: Hate speech legislation including sexual orientation as protected ground for non-discrimination complaints; violation punishable by up to one year prison or fine.
leads.detail: Cited as March 2015 Government introduction updating articles 175, 175a and 176 to include sexual orientation; no URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Surinamese Penal Code, Articles 176c and 500a
leads.documents: Prohibition of discrimination based on sexual orientation in employment and provision of goods and services.
leads.detail: Cited as articles 176c and 500a forbid discrimination in employment and goods/services; no URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Employment Equal Treatment Act 2022
leads.documents: Parliamentary act banning workplace discrimination based on race, ethnicity, religion, gender identity and sexual orientation; first protection of gender identity.
leads.detail: Cited as passed by Parliament in 2022; no URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Surinamese Penal Code, Article 302 (1910 Code amended 2015)
leads.documents: Legality of same-sex sexual activity since 1869 and equalization of age of consent to 16 regardless of sexual orientation.
leads.detail: Cited as Article 302 stipulated age 18 for same-sex acts, amended in 2015; no URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Inter-American Court of Human Rights - January 2018 ruling
leads.documents: Holds same-sex marriage is a human right protected by the American Convention on Human Rights, legally binding on Suriname.
leads.detail: Cited as January 2018 Inter-American Court ruling on same-sex marriage obligation; no URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Constitutional Court of Suriname - February 2023 ruling
leads.documents: Ruled ban on same-sex marriage does not violate constitution or Interamerican Convention obligations, but found Civil Code outdated and needing modernization after public debate.
leads.detail: Cited as February 2023 Constitutional Court ruling; no URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Judge Shanti Bikhari ruling - 13 February 2025
leads.documents: Ruled laws disallowing same-sex marriage conflict with ICCPR and Interamerican Convention on Human Rights; ordered state to change laws and Bureau of Civil Affairs to register marriages.
leads.detail: Cited as 13 February 2025 decision, noted as potentially subject to appeal; no URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Eerste Kantongerecht (Court of First Instance) - January 2017 ruling
leads.documents: Granted transgender woman right to have gender formally changed with Central Bureau of Civil Affairs and ordered registry change.
leads.detail: Cited as January 2017 Eerste Kantongerecht decision opposed by VVPES and SIV; February 2017 appeal by Central Bureau noted; no URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Suriname Court of Appeal - January 2022 ruling
leads.documents: Ruled in favor of transgender woman who underwent sex reassignment surgery in 2009 and ordered gender change on birth certificate.
leads.detail: Cited as January 2022 Court of Appeal ruling affirming gender marker change; no URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: United States Department of State - human rights reporting on Suriname
leads.documents: Documents 2014 explicit exclusion of LGBTQ people from social security legislation, anti-LGBTQ statements by MPs and then-Vice President comparing homosexuality to disease/inciting hatred, and 2015 societal discrimination in employment and housing.
leads.detail: Cited as According to the United States Department of State; no URL visible in provided text.
